Maybe I’ll change my handle here to…
Enforcer #6

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: We have actually planned out enough interwoven expansions (and related characters and storylines) to last us for a number of years. We actually planned out much of the world of Sentinels Comics before we even released the core game. As a consequence, minor clues about future characters / storylines can be found in the art and flavor text of published games (to say nothing of nemesis icons).
